selected.primary_estimand: Exercise response: change from baseline (BL) within each diet group at H0 and at H2 (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p6, S5.6.p3); diet differences at each time point are a secondary, associational estimand (S2.2.p1) and are not the requested exercise question.
selected.paper_method: mixed-effect ANOVA (car, R 3.0) + Tukey post-hoc, BH FDR (S5.6.p3)
selected.matrix_scale: RPKM (easyRNASeq), filtered at 50 mapped reads; values < 10 reads replaced by the RPKM equivalent of 10 reads (S5.6.p2)

reported_counts.LC_H0_vs_BL: 161 genes 'different at H0 vs. baseline in LC' (S2.3.p2; unclear whether total or LC-unique)
reported_counts.shared_H0: 198 genes DE at H0 irrespective of diet (both HC and LC) (S2.3.p3)
reported_counts.shared_H2: 100 DEGs shared between diets at H2 (S2.3.p6)

decisions.reason: Paper's own deposit is GSE273041 (DA.p1). Exercise effects are defined as change from BL within each diet at H0 and H2 (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p6, S5.6.p3) with FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>1. Per-contrast DEG totals are only partly unambiguous in text (S2.3.p2-p6).

checks.data_processing: FASTQs from different flow cells were combined for a given sample using NGmerge,alignment via TopHat,Assembly: ensembl Hg19,Supplementary files format and content: processed data are RPKM normalized read counts

decisions.reason: Metadata series_id GSE273041 = paper's DA accession; 60 samples = 20 athletes x 3 biopsies; 30 HiCarb / 30 LowCarb; 20 Base/IP/IP120 each; TopHat + Hg19 + RPKM matches S5.6.p2. The only supplementary matrix is GSE273041_raw_counts.txt.gz.

All 60 matrix columns match the GEO 'description' field exactly (e.g. CC39020001_1_Base). Matrix column CC39020003_1_IP20 carries a typo ('IP20') but maps exactly via description to GSM8417462, whose timepoint field is IP120 (participant id '1_IP20' carries the same typo); subject and time come from the participant-id and timepoint fields, and the participant-id suffix agrees with timepoint for every sample.

Integer fraction 0, min 0.052, max 70,799, median 1.98: linear normalized. GEO data_processing says 'processed data are RPKM normalized read counts' and S5.6.p2 describes easyRNASeq RPKM with low values replaced by the 10-read RPKM equivalent (per-gene floor ~0.109 visible). The file name 'raw_counts' is misleading; no integer counts were deposited, so count methods are excluded. 25,262 genes vs 25,282 reported in S2.1.p1 (20-gene difference).

selected.parameterization: tgrp = BL for every baseline sample, otherwise <diet>_<time>; with subject fixed effects (which absorb diet) this equals ~ subject + diet:time with diet-specific time effects; each coefficient is a within-diet change from BL
selected.estimand_type: within-subject exercise effect, per diet group

decisions.reason: 20 athletes each biopsied at BL/H0/H2 (complete, unique); diet is between-subject. Exercise estimand per paper = change from BL within each diet at H0 and H2 (4 planned contrasts).

covariates.name: subject
covariates.disposition: included (fixed-effect block for 3 biopsies per athlete)

covariates.name: diet
covariates.disposition: nested: subjects are nested in diet; diet main effect absorbed by subject; diet-specific time effects kept via tgrp

covariates.name: biopsy leg/site
covariates.disposition: excluded: not in metadata (alternate legs, S5.3.p1)

covariates.name: flow-cell/batch (CC39020 vs CC39034 prefix)
covariates.disposition: excluded: within-subject constant (all 3 biopsies of an athlete share a prefix), absorbed by subject block

selected.paper_covariance: mixed-effect model with subject random effect (S5.6.p3); fixed subject block used here

decisions.reason: Repeated biopsies per athlete; pairing complete for 20/20. Design ~ C(subject) + C(tgrp): rank 24/24, residual df 36. Fixed subject effects replace the paper's random subject intercept; for within-subject contrasts in a complete balanced design these give the same point estimates.

selected.method: limma (lmFit + contrasts.fit + eBayes, inmoose) via run_multigroup_analysis

paper_route.method: mixed-effect ANOVA (car, subject random effect) + Tukey post-hoc on RPKM, BH FDR
paper_route.reason: no executor for car Type-I mixed ANOVA + Tukey post-hoc; R car route not available in repository tools

decisions.reason: Deposited data are RPKM (linear), so count methods are invalid; limma on log2(RPKM+1) with a subject block and planned contrasts is the validated route for repeated-measures linear-normalized data. This is a declared deviation from the paper's mixed ANOVA/Tukey route.

selected.deviation_note: Paper FDR came from BH on mixed-model/Tukey p-values; here BH is applied within each limma moderated-t contrast. log2FC is the limma coefficient on log2(RPKM+1), which is compressed toward 0 for low-expressed genes relative to a log2 ratio of mean RPKM.

decisions.reason: Paper: FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (S5.6.p3), applied unchanged on the deviation route.
one limma model ~ subject + tgrp over all 60 samples
